claims.claim: 【倡议+预测】Altman 2021 提出「American Equity Fund」:对超过某估值的公司每年征市值 2.5%(以股份缴纳)、对全部私有土地征价值 2.5%(以美元缴纳),18 岁以上公民每年领现金+股份;他预测十年后 2.5 亿成年人每人约 $13,500/年。
claims.quote: The American Equity Fund would be capitalized by taxing companies above a certain valuation 2.5% of their market value each year, payable in shares transferred to the fund, and by taxing 2.5% of the value of all privately-held land, payable in dollars. All citizens over 18 would get an annual distribution, in dollars and company shares, into their accounts. ... a decade from now each of the 250 million adults in America would get about $13,500 every year.
claims.source_title: Sam Altman, 2021, Moore's Law for Everything, 个人网站
claims.notes: 说话人:OpenAI CEO(时任),本人自称「in the spirit of a conversation starter」——是倡议不是承诺。$13,500 是基于其自设的估值增长假设的预测,且他另断言技术会让 $13,500 的购买力大增,这一步无实证。机制上是财富税+土地税→全民股息,而非 Yang 式 VAT;按公司股份缴税意味着 OpenAI 这类高估值公司自身也被稀释——但当时 OpenAI 为 capped-profit 非上市结构,适用性不明。全民、永久、无条件;与本期实测(局部、有期限、定向低收入)不是同一种东西。

claims.claim: 【表态】Altman 2024-05 在 All-In 播客把「universal basic income」改口为「universal basic compute」:每人分一份 GPT-7 的算力,可自用、转卖或捐赠;同段承认「钱不会解决所有问题,肯定不会让人快乐」。时点在 OpenResearch 结果(2024-07)公布前两个月。
claims.quote: money is not going to go solve all problems it's certainly not going to make people happy but it might it might solve some problems ... I wonder if the future looks something like more like Universal basic compute than Universal basic income and everybody gets like a slice of gpt7 compute and they can use it they can resell it they can donate it to somebody to use for cancer research but but what you get is not dollars but this like productivity slice
claims.source_title: All-In Podcast, 2024-05-10, Sam Altman: Getting Fired (and Re-Hired) by OpenAI, Agents, AI Copyright issues(YouTube 原视频)
claims.notes: 逐字依据为 YouTube 自动字幕(非人工转写),媒体版本(Business Insider/TechSpot)措辞基本一致。谁受益:分发物是 OpenAI 自家产品的算力,等于把再分配载体换成发起人公司的产品——利益冲突最直接的一条。只是「I wonder」式设想,无机制、无规模、无资金来源。同段他说「2016 was a very long time ago」,即公开从现金 UBI 立场后撤。他也称自己「not a super fan of how the government has handled most policies designed to help poor people」。

claims.claim: 【预测+倡议】Altman 2025 两篇博客:承认 AGI 可能打乱「资本与劳动的力量平衡」需「早期干预」,提出给每人「compute budget」,但同时认为单纯把智能成本压到最低可能也能达到目的;并预测「整类工作会消失」,但「社会契约」会渐进改变。
claims.quote: it does seem like the balance of power between capital and labor could easily get messed up, and this may require early intervention. We are open to strange-sounding ideas like giving some “compute budget” to enable everyone on Earth to use a lot of AI, but we can also see a lot of ways where just relentlessly driving the cost of intelligence as low as possible has the desired effect.
claims.source_title: Sam Altman, 2025, Three Observations;另见 The Gentle Singularity(2025-06, https://blog.samaltman.com/the-gentle-singularity)
claims.notes: Gentle Singularity 原文:「There will be very hard parts like whole classes of jobs going away ... We probably won’t adopt a new social contract all at once」。口径演变:2021 现金+股份 → 2024 算力切片 → 2025 「compute budget」或干脆「降低智能成本」即可——后者等于把再分配问题还原为 OpenAI 的产品定价问题,无需任何转移支付。全部是表态,无承诺、无金额。

claims.claim: 【自我叙事+资助】OpenResearch 官网称其 2015 年作为 YC Research 成立、2020 年更名并「独立于 Y Combinator」,Altman 列为董事会成员;官网研究页不列资助方。NBER 论文致谢只写「NSF (#2149344) and private donors」,未点名 Altman;已预注册 AEARCTR-0006750;论文 2026-08 有修订版。
claims.quote: Established in 2015 as YC Research, OpenResearch was renamed in 2020 and is independent of Y Combinator. | This paper gratefully acknowledges funding from the NSF (#2149344) and private donors. ... The study was preregistered on the American Economic Association RCT Registry (AEARCTR-0006750).
claims.source_title: OpenResearch, About 页;Vivalt, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Miller, 2024(rev. 2026-08), The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income, NBER WP 32719
claims.notes: 「独立于 YC」≠独立于 Altman:他仍在董事会。媒体普遍报道 Altman 个人出资约 $14M(另有 OpenAI 等),但官网与论文均未点名——一手只能确认「private donors」,具体金额记 secondhand。研究页自述 1,000 处理/2,000 对照、$1,000 vs $50/月、2020–2023、伊利诺伊与得州 19 县、21–40 岁、家庭收入≤300% FPL。论文页标注「July 2024, Revised August 2026」,与 2024 版结果是否有变动需另一条线核对。没找到 Altman 对结果的一手公开回应(见 open_questions)。

claims.claim: 【预测】Musk 2016 对 CNBC 说「很有可能因自动化最终走向 UBI 或类似东西」,并说「不知道还能怎么办」。
claims.quote: There is a pretty good chance we end up with a universal basic income, or something like that, due to automation. ... Yeah, I am not sure what else one would do. I think that is what would happen.
claims.source_title: CNBC, 2016-11-04, Elon Musk: Robots will take your jobs, government will have to pay your wage
claims.notes: CNBC 是采访方,算原始采访稿;未给采访者姓名与原始视频。这是「预测」(会发生),不是「倡议」(应该做)。说话人时任 Tesla/SpaceX CEO,Tesla 当时正推自动驾驶/工厂自动化。

claims.claim: 【预测】Musk 2024-05 VivaTech 回答学生提问:良性情境下「我们大概都不会有工作」,届时是「universal high income」而非 UBI,商品服务不会短缺;他给良性情境约 80% 概率,并称真正的问题是意义。
claims.quote: in a benignant scenario uh we probably none of us will have a job um there will be but in that benign scenario there would be Universal High income uh not Universal basic income Universal High income there would be no shortage of goods or services um and I I think the benign scenario is the most likely scenario probably I don't know 80% likely ... the question will really be one of meaning
claims.source_title: Elon Musk 在 Viva Technology Paris 2024 的完整对谈(第三方上传视频)
claims.notes: 逐字依据为第三方上传视频的 YouTube 自动字幕(非 VivaTech 官方转写),CNN/Business Today 引文一致。「80%」是随口概率,不是模型输出。没有任何机制、资金来源或时间表——纯预测,不是倡议也不是承诺。「意义」部分属本期范围;「物质不再稀缺」部分属 #20,不展开。利益关联:Tesla Optimus 人形机器人、xAI;2025-11 股东批准的 CEO 绩效奖励把「1 million bots delivered」列为 operational milestone 之一(据 Tesla 10-K 片段与 IR 材料的二手摘录;SEC EDGAR 因需 UA 联系方式未直接访问)。

claims.claim: 【倡议】Musk 2026-04 在 X 发帖称「由联邦政府发支票的 universal HIGH income 是应对 AI 失业的最佳方式」,并断言 AI/机器人产出远超货币供应增量,所以不会通胀。
claims.quote: Universal HIGH INCOME via checks issued by the Federal government is the best way to deal with unemployment caused by AI ... AI/robotics will produce goods & services far in excess of the increase in the money supply, so there will not be inflation
claims.source_title: Yahoo Finance, 2026-04-17, Elon Musk says government checks are the 'best way' to deal with AI job losses(转引其 X 帖)
claims.notes: 原帖在 X,未直接抓取(X 不可匿名读取);逐字仅来自媒体嵌引,Washington Times 403。口径从 2016「预测」→2024「预测」→2026「倡议」;钱由联邦政府出,不是 Tesla/xAI 出——和 Amodei「对 AI 公司征税」形成对照。「不会通胀」是未经论证的宏观断言(属 #20 范围,不展开)。

claims.claim: 【倡议(探索)】Zuckerberg 2017 哈佛毕业演讲:「我们应该探索 UBI 之类的想法,给每个人一个尝试新事物的缓冲垫」。
claims.quote: We should explore ideas like universal basic income to give everyone a cushion to try new things.
claims.source_title: Harvard Gazette, 2017-05-25, Mark Zuckerberg's speech as written for Harvard's Class of 2017
claims.notes: 哈佛官方「as written」稿,可能与现场口播略有差异。措辞是「explore」,最弱的一档倡议;理由是创业冒险的安全垫(风险承担叙事),不是自动化失业叙事。之后未见 Meta 出资做 UBI 试点或提出机制(未系统检索,记为未见)。

claims.claim: 【预测】Amodei 2024《Machines of Loving Grace》:长期看 AI 会便宜到比较优势失效,「现有经济安排将不再合理」;解法「可能简单到一个大额全民基本收入,但我怀疑那只会是方案的一小部分」;并称意义主要来自人际关系而非经济劳动。
claims.quote: It could be as simple as a large universal basic income for everyone, although I suspect that will only be a small part of a solution. ... In any case I think meaning comes mostly from human relationships and connection, not from economic labor.
claims.source_title: Dario Amodei, 2024, Machines of Loving Grace, 个人网站
claims.notes: Anthropic CEO。UBI 被明确降级为「small part」;「意义不来自劳动」是他的价值判断,没有引用任何 UBI 实测(OpenResearch 结果此前 3 个月已公布)。同文:「we will likely have to fight to get a good outcome here: exploitative or dystopian directions are clearly also possible」。

claims.claim: 【倡议+承诺】Amodei 2026-01《The Adolescence of Technology》:对「巨大蛋糕+高度不平等」的自然政策回应是累进税,「可以是一般税,也可以专门针对 AI 公司」;并对亿万富翁说若不支持好版本「就会得到一个由暴民设计的坏版本」;另称 Anthropic 全体联合创始人承诺捐出 80% 财富。
claims.quote: The natural policy response to an enormous economic pie coupled with high inequality (due to a lack of jobs, or poorly paid jobs, for many) is progressive taxation. The tax could be general or could be targeted against AI companies in particular. ... if they don’t support a good version, they’ll inevitably get a bad version designed by a mob. ... All of Anthropic’s co-founders have pledged to donate 80% of our wealth
claims.source_title: Dario Amodei, 2026, The Adolescence of Technology, 个人网站
claims.notes: 这是本线唯一一条「对说话人自己行业征税」的倡议——但没有税率、税基或用途,且他把所有干预称为「ways to buy time」。80% 捐赠是「承诺(pledge)」,不是已执行;流向私人慈善而非公共转移,受益人由捐赠者决定。注意他把 UBI 与「慈善+税」并列,没有主张无条件现金。

claims.claim: 【预测+倡议】Amodei 2025-05 对 Axios:AI 可能在 1–5 年内消灭一半入门级白领岗位、失业率升至 10–20%;并提出「token tax」——AI 公司每笔模型收入约 3% 交给政府再分配。
claims.quote: (媒体转述)every time someone uses a model and the AI company makes money, perhaps 3% of that revenue goes to the government and is redistributed
claims.source_title: Axios, 2025-05-28, Behind the Curtain: A white-collar bloodbath(采访稿)
claims.notes: Axios 原文 403,逐字只见二手转述(the-decoder、GIGAZINE 等),3% 是否为 Amodei 原话还是 Axios 概括无法确认。10–20% 是「可能」不是基准预测。2026-01 长文改为更泛的「progressive taxation」,未再出现 3% 数字——口径收缩。2026-09 Fortune 报道众议院有按失业率自动上调的 AI 消费税提案,与其主张相关但无一手核对。

claims.claim: 【倡议】Yang 2020「Freedom Dividend」:18 岁以上公民每人每月 $1,000、无条件;资金来自 10% VAT 与合并部分福利项目,且现有福利领取者须在原福利与 $1,000 之间二选一,「不会两者都拿」。
claims.quote: Current welfare and social program beneficiaries would be given a choice between their current benefits or $1,000 cash unconditionally – most would prefer cash with no restriction. ... people already receiving benefits would have a choice between keeping their current benefits and the $1,000, and would not receive both.
claims.source_title: Yang2020 竞选网站, The Freedom Dividend, Defined(Wayback 存档)
claims.notes: 竞选承诺(campaign promise),非政策。二选一设计意味着对最穷的福利领取者净增量可能接近 0,增量主要流向不领福利的人——与 Hoynes & Rothstein 的「替代 vs 叠加」分析(V21/V22)正好对上。网页称「1 out of 3 American workers are at risk of losing their jobs」为未注明来源的预测。Tax Foundation 估算 10% VAT 只够约一半成本(二手)。

claims.claim: 【倡议】Chris Hughes 与 Economic Security Project:ESP 自述「为所有美国人争取 guaranteed income」;Hughes 2018 推的方案是把 EITC 改为按月、给「每个有工作的人」$500/月——即有工作条件的保障收入,不是 UBI。ESP 是 Stockton SEED 首列捐赠方。
claims.quote: We're fighting for a guaranteed income to provide basic security for all Americans. | (Hughes 对 CNBC)We can provide a guaranteed income of $500 to every working person in America
claims.source_title: Economic Security Project, About 页;CNBC 2018-02-24 采访;SEED 2019 Discussion Paper
claims.notes: ESP 自述与 SEED 捐赠名单(Economic Security Project、Goldhirsh Foundation、Future Justice Fund、California Wellness Foundation)逐字核对;Hughes 引语来自 CNBC 采访稿(经抓取工具摘录),《Fair Shot》书中原文未核。$50,000 门槛是 CNBC 转述。关键口径:倡导方同时是试点资助方(SEED),评估由合作研究者做——「出钱的人也定义了成功」。ESP 官网未披露自身资助方。

claims.claim: 【倡导方】GiveDirectly 肯尼亚 UBI 研究官网自述为「$30M 项目」、约 2.3 万人/195 村、长期臂 $22.50/月×12 年,并称转移「让村里每个人脱离(货币)贫困」;其政策倡导页把「一次性大额现金」列为优先,没有关于 UBI/保障收入的政策立场;官网不列资助方。
claims.quote: As part of this $30M project, we have distributed millions of dollars to ~23,000 individuals living across 195 villages. ... These transfers lift everyone in a village out of (monetary) poverty. | Position large, one-time cash transfers as a core tool to reduce extreme poverty.
claims.source_title: GiveDirectly, UBI 研究页与 Policy & Advocacy 页
claims.notes: 同页 FAQ 写的是 2 万人/197 村,与正文不一致。「lift everyone out of poverty」是机械算术(把月转移加到收入上),不是实测福利效应。资助方:官网/财务页不点名;二手资料只确认 Omidyar Network 2017 年 $493,000;GiveWell/Open Philanthropy 对 GiveDirectly 的一般捐助未核到 UBI 专项。注意倡导重点是「一次性大额」而非「终身月付」——GiveDirectly 自己的政策优先与「UBI」标签并不重合。

claims.claim: 【对手方/政府】芬兰政府 2018-04 决定不扩大基本收入试验(Kela 曾申请把在职低收入者纳入),试验按原计划 2017–2018 两年结束;Kela 强调「不是提前叫停」。政府未给出一手可查的书面理由。
claims.quote: The government has decided not to expand the programme ... The effects of the experiment will not be published while the experiment is in progress.
claims.source_title: Yle News, 2018-04-25, 报道 Kela 声明
claims.notes: Kela 原始新闻稿与政府(STM/财政部)书面理由均未抓到。二手(Bath IPR blog、Global Government Forum)把原因归于预算与同期「activation model」(要求求职者 3 个月内工作满 18 小时或参训)——即政府转向有条件激活,方向与 UBI 相反;这是研究者解读,不是政府原话。媒体「芬兰放弃 UBI」的说法不准确:试验从来就只设计了两年,样本 2,000 名失业者、€560/月。

claims.claim: 【对手方/立法】爱达荷 2024 与南达科他 2024 立法禁止地方政府搞「保障收入项目」,定义都是「定期、无条件、可任意使用的现金」,并明确豁免要求求职/工作/参训的项目——禁的是「无条件」,不是「给钱」。
claims.quote: "guaranteed income program" means a plan funded or administered by the government under which an individual is provided with regular, unconditional cash payments to be used for any purpose by the individual. "Guaranteed income program" does not include a program under which an individual is required to seek reemployment, perform work, or attend training as a condition of any payments.
claims.source_title: Idaho Code Title 56 Ch. 20(2024 ch. 224,2025 重编号);South Dakota Codified Law 8-5-15(SL 2024 ch 27)
claims.notes: 爱达荷 56-2002:「a county, city, agency, board, or any other political subdivision of this state shall not adopt or enforce any law ... for the purpose of making payments to individuals under a guaranteed income program ... null and void」。南达科他 8-5-15 现行文本(我抓到的版本)只写 township,并由州检察长起诉——早期报道称 SB 115 覆盖 county/township/municipality,可能分散在多条法条,未逐条核。这些州当时多无本地试点:属预防性立法。

claims.claim: 【对手方/立法】艾奥瓦 HF 2319(2024)禁止县、市开办或延长保障收入项目,由州检察长发停止令并起诉;已运行项目最晚只能撑到 2025-01-01;立即生效。
claims.quote: Unless expressly authorized by state law, a county shall not adopt, enforce, or maintain an ordinance, order, or rule for the purpose of making payments to individuals under a guaranteed income program. ... A guaranteed income program operating prior to or on the effective date of this Act may remain in effect until January 1, 2025, or until expiration of the program, whichever is earlier.
claims.source_title: Iowa General Assembly, 2024, House File 2319 (Enrolled)
claims.notes: 定义:「regular periodic cash payments that are unearned and that may be used for any purpose, but does not include a program under which an individual is required to perform work or attend training」。直接针对 Polk 县 UpLift 试点(二手:试点改由私人资金续跑)。立法只切断「地方公共资金」,不禁止私人慈善——所以私人资助的 RCT(如 OpenResearch)不受影响,但这让「政府能否做」这一政策问题无法在这些州被检验。

claims.claim: 【对手方/立法+司法】得州 SB 2010(2025)参议院 22–9 通过但死于众议院;委员会报告记录提案人理由为保障收入项目「不公平地再分配纳税人资金……加剧而非减轻贫困」。同期得州最高法院 2024 年起冻结哈里斯县 Uplift Harris($500/月)发放。
claims.quote: The bill sponsor has informed the committee that these programs redistribute taxpayer funds unfairly, ultimately undermining their intended purpose by pulling resources from the very communities they aim to support, exacerbating poverty rather than alleviating it.
claims.source_title: Texas House Intergovernmental Affairs Committee, 2025, Bill Analysis S.B. 2010 (Bettencourt)
claims.notes: 「加剧贫困」是提案人主张,委员会报告未附任何证据。法案还豁免「short-term ... nonrenewable」且要求求职/工作/参训的项目——同样只禁无条件。立法结局(死于众议院 Calendars)与 Uplift Harris 诉讼(Paxton 以宪法「禁止赠与公款」起诉,得州最高法院 2024-04 冻结、2024-06 延续,Blacklock 撰文)均为二手(KERA/KUT、Houston Landing),最高法院意见原文未抓。阿肯色 2023 HB 1681「Work Protection Act」(Act 822)与堪萨斯 2025 HB 2101 同类,未抓到全文。

claims.claim: 【调查】Pew 2020-07/08:问「联邦政府为所有成年公民——无论是否工作——提供约 $1,000/月的保障收入」,54% 反对、45% 支持;共和党及倾向者 78% 反对(62% 强烈反对),民主党及倾向者 66% 支持;30 岁以下 67% 支持,65+ 72% 反对;黑人 73%、西语裔 63%、白人 35% 支持。
claims.quote: Would you favor or oppose the federal government providing a guaranteed income, sometimes called a “Universal Basic Income,” of about $1,000 a month for all adult citizens, whether or not they work?
claims.source_title: Pew Research Center, 2020, American Trends Panel Wave 71 Topline;短文 Gilberstadt, 2020-08-19, More Americans oppose than favor...
claims.notes: 口径陷阱:全样本 N=11,001,但这道题只问了 Form 2(N=5,501)。topline:强烈支持 23 / 有些支持 22 / 有些反对 18 / 强烈反对 36。措辞没有提 AI 或自动化,也没提资金来源;时点在疫情纾困支票期间,可能抬高支持度。

claims.claim: 【调查】框架效应:当问题设定为「若机器人/计算机能做很多人类工作」时,Pew 2017 有 60% 支持政府保障收入(民主党 77% vs 共和党 38%);Gallup/Northeastern 2017 问「作为帮助因 AI 失业者的方式」支持 48%/反对 52%,支持者中仅 46% 愿意自己多交税。
claims.quote: majorities would also support providing all Americans with a guaranteed income that would allow people to meet their basic needs (60% in favor) ... (77% of Democrats favor this idea, compared with just 38% of Republicans)
claims.source_title: Pew Research Center, 2017, Automation in Everyday Life;Gallup/Northeastern, 2018-02-26, Public Split on Basic Income for Workers Replaced by Robots
claims.notes: Gallup:2017-09-15 至 10-10 邮寄调查 N=3,297,±2pp;分党派支持 D 65 / I 48 / R 28;愿意多交税的支持者 D 55 / I 40 / R 29。三份调查的数字(60% / 48% / 45%)不能直接比:Pew 2017 是假设情境 + 「满足基本需要」,Gallup 限定「AI 失业者」,Pew 2020 是「无论是否工作」+具体金额。2025–2026 的新调查未找到一手(见 open_questions)。

claims.claim: 【论证/制度设计】Hoynes & Rothstein 2019:向每位 18+ 美国居民每年 $12,000 的「标准 UBI」约 $3 万亿/年,约为 2017 年联邦总支出的 75%;若保留社保、Medicare、Medicaid,其余全部转移项目只够覆盖约五分之一成本;排除 65 岁以上可降约五分之一。
claims.quote: A universal payment of $12,000 per year to each adult U.S. resident over age 18 would cost roughly $3 trillion per year. This is about 75 percent of current total federal expenditures, including all on- and off-budget items, in 2017. ... If Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid are preserved, the remaining programs in Table 3 together would cover only about one-fifth of the cost of the canonical UBI.
claims.source_title: Hilary Hoynes & Jesse Rothstein, 2019, Universal Basic Income in the US and Advanced Countries, NBER WP 25538 / Annual Review of Economics 11
claims.notes: 逐字取自 NBER 工作论文版(注明为 Annual Review of Economics UBI 专题约稿),期刊版页码/措辞可能微调。$3T 是毛成本,未扣回收税收;作者强调「taxes ... are likely of first-order importance」。用标准弹性(收入弹性 -0.05 到 -0.10)推算 $12,000 UBI 使工时下降 1.6%–3.3%。摘要直说:「the ongoing UBI pilot studies will do little to resolve the major outstanding questions」——对本期所有试点证据的外推性是关键警告。作者为学术经济学家,无已知厂商利益。

claims.claim: 【论证/制度设计】Hoynes & Rothstein:相对现有转移体系,UBI 会把更大份额转向无子女、非老年、非残障与中等收入家庭;若「替代」现有项目则对最低收入家庭帮助大减,若「叠加」并由累进税融资则是很大的向下再分配。
claims.quote: A UBI would direct much larger shares of transfers to childless, non-elderly, non-disabled households than existing programs, and much more to middle-income rather than poor households. A UBI large enough to increase transfers to low-income families would be enormously expensive.
claims.source_title: Hilary Hoynes & Jesse Rothstein, 2019, Universal Basic Income in the US and Advanced Countries, NBER WP 25538
claims.notes: 正文:「If a UBI of the scale often contemplated were introduced on top of the existing transfer system, it would represent a very large downward redistribution of income. In contrast, a UBI that replaced, rather than supplemented, current programs would be less targeted, providing much less assistance to the lowest income families.」这是评价 Yang(二选一)、Musk(联邦支票)、Altman(资本税股息)的同一把尺:关键不是发不发钱,而是「替代还是叠加、谁出税」。老年家庭平均社保 $17,400 + 医保精算值 $12,900,替代后老人转移收入降超三分之一。

claims.claim: 【官方/制度设计】阿拉斯加 PFD 的「分红」并不在宪法里:宪法第 9 条第 15 节只规定至少 25% 矿产收入进入永久基金、本金只能投资、收益「除法律另有规定外存入普通基金」;州最高法院 2017 年裁定基金收益「受正常拨款与否决程序约束」,支持州长 2016 年把分红砍到 $1,022;2025 年分红由立法机关 HB 53 定为 $1,000。
claims.quote: The legislature's use of Permanent Fund income is subject to normal appropriation and veto budgetary processes. ... Absent another constitutional amendment, the Permanent Fund dividend program must compete for annual legislative funding just as other state programs.
claims.source_title: Wielechowski v. State, 403 P.3d 1141 (Alaska 2017);Alaska Department of Revenue, 2025-09-22 新闻稿
claims.notes: 宪法原文(经判决引用):「All income from the permanent fund shall be deposited in the general fund unless otherwise provided by law.」2016:立法拨款 $13.62 亿,州长否决到 $6.9565 亿,分红约为预期一半。DOR:「The amount of this year’s PFD was determined by the Alaska Legislature in House Bill 53」,发放对象 60 余万人。二手:法定公式下 2025 应约 $3,892。启示:全民、永久、无条件的唯一美国先例,其金额每年由政治决定——「永久」只是法律惯性,不是宪法保障;这对 Altman 式「全民股息」的可持续性是直接反例。AS 37.13.145 法条原文与 2018 POMV(5% 提取)法条未抓。

claims.claim: 【倡议/变体】UCL IGP 2017 提出 Universal Basic Services(住房、食物、交通、信息),称总成本约 £42bn(英国 GDP 的 2.3%),可通过调整个人免税额实现财政中性;对比按求职者津贴水平向全民发 UBI 约 £250bn/年(约 13% GDP)。
claims.quote: (转述)The total cost of £42bn – representing 2.3% of UK GDP – could be fully funded through changes to the Personal Allowance, making the proposal fiscally neutral
claims.source_title: UCL Institute for Global Prosperity, 2017, Social Prosperity for the Future: A Proposal for Universal Basic Services
claims.notes: UCL 页面与报告 PDF 均 403,数字来自 UCL Bartlett 摘要的搜索片段与 P2P Foundation 转述,未逐字核对。批评(RSA Painter,二手):「universal」名不副实,最大受益是约 150 万获免费住房的家庭,人人都拿到的只有约 £5 的宽带/手机。该方案为论证型,无实测;与现金 UBI 的取舍是「选择自由 vs 成本与针对性」。
